title: Bright Smiles Dental Studio
tagline: A fully animated dental clinic website concept — built to show what a modern healthcare site can look like.
overview: Bright Smiles Dental Studio is a self-initiated concept build — a fictional clinic used to demonstrate what a modern, conversion-focused healthcare website looks like: a full animated single-page site with a booking flow, team profiles, service breakdown, and patient testimonials.
problem: Most local clinic websites look the same — static, dated, and built years ago. Prospective clients rarely see a live example of what a genuinely modern, animated clinic site could feel like before committing to a rebuild.
solution: Designed and built a complete single-page clinic experience from scratch: animated hero with floating UI, scroll-triggered reveals on every section, animated stat counters, an interactive FAQ accordion, and a working appointment booking form with a real success state — all in a calming teal-and-white healthcare palette.
results: A live, fully working demo that shows the full range of what's possible for a clinic or healthcare client — motion design, booking UX, and a mobile-responsive layout — used as proof of capability for prospective healthcare clients.
